app_summary: An online shop selling astronomy products, based on the OpenTelemetry Demo. Supported Operations: View product catalog, Receive product recommendations and ads, Add item to cart, Checkout with selected items, Currency conversion, Process payment, Generate shipping quotes, Send order confirmation emails
